persona: Product designer who runs most of the team's research
resumeText:
Meera Iyer | Bengaluru | meera.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Product Designer, Kanakapura Fintech Labs, Bengaluru (2021 - present)
- Designed loan application screens and prototypes in Figma for the mobile app.
- Ran 24 moderated usability tests on the loan flow with first-time borrowers.
- Conducted 30 user interviews in Kannada and Hindi with small shop owners.
- Ran affinity mapping workshops to group interview notes into themes.
- Presented research readouts to product managers and engineers every sprint.
- Agreed the quarterly research plan with the product and engineering leads.

Junior UI Designer, Lalbagh Digital Studio, Bengaluru (2020 - 2021)
- Made marketing banners and app screens for retail clients.

SKILLS
Figma, user research, Qualtrics, Miro

EDUCATION
BDes Interaction Design, Srishti Institute, 2020
